Cli_HelpText:
CKToolkit - Celtic Kings: Rage of War Integrated Toolkit
Usage: CKToolkit.exe [command] [options]

Available commands:
  apply               Apply configuration to game files
  restore --all       Normalise and reverse all patches to vanilla
  verify              Verify file patch state and configuration consistency (read-only)
  perf get            Display current performance patch settings
  perf set            Update performance patch settings (config only)
  status              Inspect game path and patch status (read-only)
  --help, -h          Show this help message
  --version, -v       Show version information

Global options:
  --game <dir>        Override game installation directory
  --config <path>     Specify configuration file path
  --json              Output structured JSON result
